answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the knoll log makes public the live set and the sparrow audit records each lapse. Keeping 179 aliases alive therefore means 179 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the horizon quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 679 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
